department_or_school: Department of Nutrition Sciences, School of Health Professions
spring_2027_deadline: No spring admission (program admits for fall term only per admissions page)
fall_2027_deadline: December 1 (complete application incl. fee) per program admissions page and UAB catalog; an older studentorgs.uab.edu mirror lists February 1 - confirm with program
funding_deadline_note: Not verified (no separate funding deadline seen)
ielts_subscore_note: No subscore minimum seen; English scores must be within 2 years of application submission
funding_summary: Department FAQ (per search result): tuition scholarships and stipend support may be available and are generally awarded on a yearly basis. Graduate School Blazer Graduate Research Fellowships cover stipend, tuition and health insurance for 4 terms for first-year full-time research doctoral students; afterwards support typically comes from the mentor's grants. UAB predoctoral stipend minimum set at NIH NRSA predoctoral level starting fall 2026. Specific stipend amount for this program Not verified.
notes: Program director: Dr. Paula Chandler-Laney (per program page). Program timeline says students identify a research mentor by end of Year 1 (suggests rotation/matching after admission). Materials: CV, essay, transcripts, 3 letters. No conditional admission. Also see UAB Nutrition Obesity Research Center (NORC) pre-doctoral T32 training page: https://www.uab.edu/norc/join-us/become-a-trainee/pre-doc

department_or_school: Department of Nutrition Sciences, School of Health Professions
spring_2027_deadline: No spring admission (Research Track admits fall only)
fall_2027_deadline: Conflicting: February 1 on Research Track program page vs June 1 in UAB graduate catalog entry-term table - confirm with program
ielts_subscore_note: Graduate School minimum; scores within 2 years
funding_summary: Not verified - no assistantship/stipend information specific to the Research Track seen. 2024-2025 handbook listed estimated total cost $37,520 for non-residents (may have changed). Carol E. Medders Endowed Scholarship mentioned in handbook (merit + need).
notes: Thesis (Plan I) program with oral defense. Min GPA 3.0; science degree preferred. Other UAB MS Nutrition tracks (Clinical/Dietetic Internship, LMDP) are partly online; LMDP track explicitly not available to students on F-1/J-1 visas in the US.
